title: Space Force people ask about Hawkeye 360 detecting UAP signals at SCU
summary: Bob Maguire tells of Space Force people ask about Hawkeye 360 detecting UAP signals at SCU, about 2022 at Redstone Arsenal, Huntsville, Alabama, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: went there in 2022 and people associated with space force from three-letter agencies came off to me and talk to me about applying Hawkeye abilities to just looking for UAP signals on the ground

plain: Bob Maguire, who says he worked as a contractor for the CIA, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2022 he went to a meeting of the Scientific Coalition for UAP Studies, a group that studies unexplained aerial phenomena, in Huntsville, Alabama. He says people tied to the Space Force, the US military branch for space, and to intelligence agencies approached him about using the signal-detecting abilities of a company called Hawkeye 360 to look for signals from unexplained objects on the ground.
